content:
We have carbon NMR data: chemical shifts: 168.60, 143.85, 130.30, 22.80, 21.35, 19.20 ppm.

We need number of CH3 groups (methyl). In 13C NMR, methyl carbons appear around 10-30 ppm (alkyl). Here we have three signals in that region: 22.80, 21.35, 19.20. Likely three methyl carbons. Need to ensure none are other types like methylene (CH2) also in that region but typical CH2 ~20-40 as well. But we have three distinct low-field signals; could be three methyls or maybe two methyls and one methylene. Need more info. Could use proton NMR to see number of methyl protons. Let's get proton NMR.
